story.heading: Connecticut'S TRUSTED TREE & VEGETATION EXPERTS
paragraphs: Erick’s Tree Services has been proudly serving residential and commercial properties across Connecticut with professional, safe, and reliable tree care solutions. Built on a foundation of quality workmanship, dependable service, and customer satisfaction, our company is committed to helping property owners maintain safe, clean, and well-managed outdoor spaces.

Our experienced team specializes in tree removal, trimming, stump grinding, land clearing, emergency storm cleanup, and outdoor property services. Every project is approached with professionalism, precision, and a strong focus on safety, ensuring the work is completed efficiently while protecting your property and surrounding environment.

We take pride in delivering reliable service backed by experienced crews, professional equipment, and industry-standard safety practices. Whether handling routine maintenance or urgent emergency situations, our goal is to provide solutions our clients can trust.

At Erick’s Tree Services, we believe strong customer relationships are built through honest communication, dependable work, and consistent results. We are committed to delivering professional service that homeowners, businesses, and property managers across Connecticut can rely on.

faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our tree removal Connecticut services.

items.question: How much does tree removal cost?
items.answer: The cost of tree removal depends on factors such as tree size, location, and job complexity. We offer free, personalized estimates for every customer. Contact us today for a no-obligation quote.

items.question: What method do you use for stump removal?
items.answer: We use professional stump grinding equipment to grind the stump several inches below grade, then clean up the debris so the area is ready for grass, mulch, or replanting.

items.question: Do you provide 24/7 emergency services?
items.answer: Yes. Storms and fallen limbs never wait for business hours, so our emergency crew is on call around the clock to make your property safe as quickly as possible.

items.question: Are you licensed and insured?
items.answer: Absolutely. We are fully licensed and carry comprehensive liability and workers' compensation insurance, so you are protected on every job we perform.

items.question: What method do you use for stump removal?
items.answer: For most residential jobs we grind the stump, but for larger commercial sites we can fully excavate the root ball when the space needs to be completely cleared.

items.question: How long does it take to remove or prune a tree?
items.answer: Most standard removals and pruning jobs are completed within a single day. Larger or more complex trees near structures or power lines may take longer, and we will give you a clear timeline up front.

items.question: Do you offer any discounts?
items.answer: We offer seasonal promotions as well as discounts for seniors, veterans, and repeat customers. Ask us about current offers when you request your free quote.
